[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Jalaka''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who once held a party that was infiltrated by [[Cryle Cavv]] and [[Sienn Sconn]] as part of criminal operation. During the mission, Sconn ended up falling in Jalaka's pool.<ref name="TFO" />
